text_block_list.text:
...There's somewhere I have to go after
the race.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: There's a few words I want to say to her once I've got victory in hand.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...All right.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Yo, Brian!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: What do you want, O Queen of the Amazons?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hey, don't make it weird, Beast.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Hmph...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Haha, what are you sulking for? You
started it.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, how do you plan on running
now?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I don't know if you realize it or not, but
the way
you run is having an impact on
others.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: I know 'cause that includes me.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Are your prepared to shoulder that kind
of
responsibility?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...That's why I'm going to get stronger.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I was influenced by someone else, the
same as
you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
This is the Twinkle Series, where only
those with
conviction gather.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because we have the drive
to
continue running that we keep
fighting.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll keep challenging you.
I've got no
interest in boring races, after
all.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Even after you've got no one left to chase, I'll be coming for you.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Yeah...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
All right, then. You and me, one-on-one.
For as
long as we both can stand.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
